name: Chicken Fajitas
desc: Spiced chicken strips with quick-seared peppers and onions in warm flour tortillas.

source.title: Chicken Fajitas Recipe
source.evidence: Same skillet fajita: chicken breast tossed in oil, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, paprika, onion powder and pepper, three bell peppers, one onion, and 8 small flour tortillas.

ingredients.raw: 3 medium boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 1 1/2 lb)
1 medium yellow onion, cut into thin slivers
3 bell peppers (mixed colors), sliced 1/4 inch thick
1 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste

steps: Cut the onion into slivers and slice the peppers.

In a large bowl, combine 1 tbsp oil, the juice of half the lime, the chili powder, smoked paprika, onion powder, black pepper, cumin, and salt. Cut the chicken into 1/2-inch-thick strips and toss to coat.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large heavy skillet (cast iron works well) over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in batches in a single layer, turning once, until browned and 165°F inside, 3 to 5 minutes per batch. Transfer to a plate.

Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet. Cook the onion 2 minutes, add the peppers, and cook 2 minutes more, until crisp-tender and browned in spots. Return the chicken and toss to reheat. Taste and add salt if needed.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, about 20 seconds per side. Squeeze the remaining lime half over the fajitas and serve in the warm tortillas.
tips: The chicken can sit in the spice mixture in the fridge for up to 4 hours.
Natasha's Kitchen cooks the peppers 5 to 6 minutes for softer fajitas; this version keeps them crisp.
